name: Google Flow
summary: Google's AI filmmaking workspace for generating and editing video clips with Veo and related models.
description:
Google Flow is Google's creative video workspace built on generative models such as Veo. It lets creators storyboard scenes, generate shots, and refine clips in a guided flow tied to Google accounts.

Feature: Scene-based video generation with Veo models. Feature: Integrated editing and extension of clips. Feature: Works with Google AI subscription tiers. Feature: Export for social or further editing.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Included in Google AI Pro/Ultra subscriptions where Flow is available.

howToUse.title: Open Flow
howToUse.description: Sign in with a Google account that has Flow access and start a new project.

howToUse.title: Outline your story
howToUse.description: Describe scenes or upload references Flow accepts, then generate initial clips.

howToUse.title: Iterate shots
howToUse.description: Regenerate, extend, or adjust prompts per scene until the sequence fits.

howToUse.title: Export
howToUse.description: Download or send finished clips to your editor or publishing workflow.
